'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[2021 Niger attacks]]
***[[Boko Haram]] [[jihadist]]s raid the town of [[Diffa]], killing four [[civilian]]s and four [[Niger Armed Forces|soldiers]]. Six attackers are killed by responding security forces. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/boko-haram-militants-kill-8-southeastern-niger-says-defence-ministry-2021-05-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Stresa–Mottarone cable car crash]]
**Three people arrested for the [[Aerial lift|cable car]] crash that killed 14 people in [[Mottarone]], [[Piedmont]], Italy, are released by a court order. A [[technician]] who worked on the [[Stresa–Alpino–Mottarone Cable Car]] line which operated the cable car remains under [[house arrest]] and has been named the party responsible for the accident. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/05/30/judge-finds-technician-responsible-for-cable-car-crash-over-mottarone-mountain-in-italy (Euronews)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Afghanistan]]
****[[Afghanistan]] reports a record of 929 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 71,690. [https://www.bignewsnetwork.com/news/269695749/afghanistan-registers-929-covid-19-cases-in-highest-daily-spike (Big News Network)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]], [[Malaysian movement control order]]
****The [[Malaysia]]n [[Government of Malaysia|government]] announces that all [[Shopping mall|malls]] will have to close on total [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] from June 1 to 14, while 17 essential service will be allowed to operate. The government also allow companies under 12 manufacturing sector to be continue operating with 60% capacity. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/malaysia-covid19-total-lockdown-malls-shut-17-essential-services-14914314 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****The [[Government of the Republic of China|government]] signs a deal with Medigen Vaccine Biologics Corp and United Biomedical Inc to provide up to 20 million doses of their [[COVID-19 vaccine]]s in [[Taiwan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taiwan-reports-further-rise-domestic-covid-19-cases-2021-05-30/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] surpasses 1,000 deaths from [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2123971/covid-deaths-top-1-000-cases-pass-150-000 (''Bangkok Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kenya]]
****[[Kenya]] extends its nightly curfew and ban on political gatherings and processions that could turn into [[superspreader event]]s for 60 days as part of an attempt to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.news24.com/amp/news24/africa/news/kenya-extends-covid-19-curfew-by-60-days-20210530 (''News24'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
****[[South Africa]]n [[President of South Africa|President]] [[Cyril Ramaphosa]] announces that the COVID-19 restrictions will be strengthened, which will include a nightly curfew from 11:00 p.m. to 4:00 a.m., a ban on gatherings of more than 100 people indoors and 250 people outdoors, and a requirement for all non-essential establishments to close at 10:00 p.m. as the country moves to the adjusted level 2 beginning tomorrow amid a third wave of COVID-19. [https://businesstech.co.za/news/trending/494469/south-africa-moves-to-adjusted-lockdown-level-2-here-are-the-key-restrictions-in-place/amp/ (BusinessTech)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
***[[Monarchy of Spain|King]] [[Felipe VI]] receives his first dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://royalcentral.co.uk/europe/spain/king-felipe-of-spain-receives-covid-19-vaccine-in-madrid-160876/?fbclid=IwAR2ENW9PvNdNXGC-4cYqusmVLgDQiQx6mbWtjKi8O6gHkffRPbfiofeoPNY (Royal Central)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Malian coup d'état]]
**The leaders of the [[Economic Community of West African States]] decide to suspend [[Mali]]'s membership in the organization until the end of February 2022 or when the country appoints a civilian [[Prime Minister of Mali|prime minister]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/africa/ecowas-suspends-mali-s-membership-over-twin-coups-47118 (TRT World)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Hialeah shooting]]
**Two people are killed and 20 more are wounded in a [[mass shooting]] at a hall near [[Hialeah, Florida]], United States. The three perpetrators remain at large. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/05/30/us/florida-shooting/index.html (CNN International)]
*[[Sri Lanka]]'s Marine Environment Protection Authority announces that it will take legal action against the owners of the Singaporean [[container ship]] ''[[X-Press Pearl]]'' for the [[marine pollution]] caused by the ship's fire off the coast of [[Colombo]] on May 20. The authority reports that [[Plastic resin pellet pollution|plastic granules]] from spilled cargo had been washing up on the Sri Lankan coast since May 27. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1626614/sri-lanka-to-sue-singapore-ship-owners-over-marine-pollution (''Dawn'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020–2021 United States racial unrest]]
**Hundreds of [[African Americans|Black]] gun owners from around the US marched in [[Tulsa, Oklahoma]] to remember those murdered in the [[Tulsa race massacre]] on the eve of its 100th anniversary. The Elmer Geronimo Pratt Gun Club of [[Austin, Texas]] and [[New Black Panther Party]] organized the event. Slogans of "[[Black Power]]" and "[[Black Lives Matter]]" were heard during the rally. [https://www.kjrh.com/news/local-news/2nd-amendment-march-attracts-hundreds-throughout-downtown-tulsa (KJRH-TV)]
*[[2021 Cypriot legislative election]]
**[[Greek Cypriots]] head to the polls to elect a new session to the [[House of Representatives (Cyprus)|House of Representatives]]. Analysts predict a fragmented parliament, as issues of corruption spurred by a scandal involving the country's "[[Immigrant investor programs|citizenship through investment]]" program last year, and the lack of progress on the [[Cyprus dispute]], has reduced support for the three main parties. [https://www.dw.com/en/amid-corruption-and-division-greek-cypriots-to-elect-new-parliament/a-57699702 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[2019–2021 Israeli political crisis]]
**[[Yamina]] leader [[Naftali Bennett]] announces that he and [[Yesh Atid]] leader [[Yair Lapid]] have formed a coalition government to oust [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]. In response, Netanyahu accuses Bennett of committing the "fraud of the [[21st century|century]]". [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-may-30-2021/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/.premium-netanyahu-accuses-bennett-of-committing-fraud-of-the-century-with-coalition-efforts-1.9859023 (''Haaretz'')]
 
'''Sports'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on association football]]
**[[2021 Copa América]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[CONMEBOL]] announces that [[Argentina]] will no longer host the [[Copa América]] tournament, two weeks before its commencement, due to the worsening of the COVID-19 pandemic in the country. [https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/copa-america-no-host-after-argentina-dropped-due-to-covid/ (''The Seattle Times'')]
*[[2020–21 Liga MX season]]
**[[Cruz Azul]] defeat [[Santos Laguna]] in the final of the [[Guardianes 2021]] championship, ending the second-longest championship drought in the top flight of Mexican soccer. Cruz Azul's drought lasted for 23 years and 6 months, while the current longest drought belonging to [[Atlas F.C.]] has been ongoing for 66 years. [https://en.as.com/en/2021/05/31/football/1622480038_030591.html (''Diario AS'')]
*[[2021 Italian motorcycle Grand Prix]]
**[[Switzerland|Swiss]] professional [[motorcycle racing|motorcycle racer]] [[Jason Dupasquier]] dies following a collision with [[Ayumu Sasaki]] at a qualifying race for the [[2021 Italian motorcycle Grand Prix]] in [[Scarperia e San Piero]], [[Tuscany]], [[Italy]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/jason-dupasquier-moto3-motorcycle-racer-dies-after-crash-at-italian-grand-prix-qualifying-12320823 (Sky News)]
*[[2021 Giro d'Italia]]
**[[Colombia]]n cyclist [[Egan Bernal]] retains both the [[General classification in the Giro d'Italia|General Classification]] and the [[Young rider classification in the Giro d'Italia|Young Rider Classification]] in the 2021 edition of the [[Giro d'Italia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/cycling/57272624 (BBC Sport)]
*[[2021 IndyCar Series]], [[2021 Indianapolis 500]]
**[[Hélio Castroneves]] wins the 105th running of the [[Indianapolis 500]]. It is Castroneves' fourth victory in the race, becoming only the fourth driver to accomplish this feat. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/05/30/us/indy-500-winner-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
